lines.en: label beachmas5:
scene sky
My search for Yumi is as fruitless as the trees covering this beach as I make my way back to the area most of the girls have been hanging out at.
lines.zh: 我寻找 Yumi 的结果，就像覆盖这片海滩的树一样贫瘠，而我一路走回大多数女孩聚集的那片区域。

lines.en: Perhaps the gap in time between the last time I truly hung out with her and now has depreciated my once great ability to always find her.
lines.zh: 也许从上次我真正和她相处到现在之间的那段空白，已经把我曾经总能找到她的那种本事折旧掉了。

lines.en: Or perhaps the only reason I ever found her at all is because she wanted to be found.
lines.zh: 又或者，我之所以总能找到她，唯一的原因是她想被我找到。

lines.en: Now, I’m not so sure anymore.
lines.zh: 现在，我不太确定了。

lines.en: Because not only did I abandon my blossoming desire to fight for her when it mattered most, I have forced myself upon her in a way different from what I’ve done in the past.
lines.zh: 因为我不只在最该为她而战的时候，放弃了那份刚刚萌芽的、想为她拼搏的念头，我还以一种与过去不同的方式，把自己强加到了她身上。

lines.en: And it doesn’t help that it seems she’s given up on fighting for herself as well.
lines.zh: 而看起来她似乎也放弃了为自己而战，这一点更是雪上加霜。

lines.en: But alas — I will resign myself to what was decided earlier and simply fall back into line.
lines.zh: 但唉——我就认了先前定下的事，乖乖回到队伍里吧。

lines.en: I will act normally.
lines.zh: 我会表现正常。

lines.en: I will disregard the jump in time that took me from one holiday to the next.
lines.zh: 我会无视那场把我从一个节日带到下一个节日的时间跳跃。

lines.en: And I will eagerly await the next instance of the world reverting to an earlier version of itself.
lines.zh: 而我会热切地等待下一次世界回退到它自己更早版本的时候。

lines.en: Perhaps next time, something greater will happen.
lines.zh: 也许下一次，会有更重大的事情发生。

lines.en: And things will go back to a time when they were easier.
lines.zh: 而一切会回到一个更轻松的时候。

lines.en: : Yay! You’re back!
lines.zh: : 耶！你回来了！

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas1
: Do you know how many seconds you were away?
lines.zh: : 你知道你离开了多少秒吗？

lines.en: : Please tell me you didn’t count them.
lines.zh: : 请告诉我你没有数。

lines.en: : Fine. I didn’t count them.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我没数。

lines.en: : You counted them, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你数了，对吧？

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas2
: It’s possible. But that’s beside the point!
lines.zh: : 有可能。不过那不是重点！

lines.en: : Right. And I’m assuming the actual point you’re trying to make is the fact that you’ve missed me despite my disappearance only lasting probably thirty minutes or so?
lines.zh: : 对。那么我猜你想说的重点是——尽管我大概只消失了三十分钟左右，你还是很想我？

lines.en: : And also the fact that I think we should spend the rest of the day together because we love each other so very much.
lines.zh: : 还有就是，我觉得我们今天剩下的时间应该待在一起，因为我们非常非常相爱。

lines.en: : I don’t see how that’s different from your approach to every single day that has ever happened.
lines.zh: : 我看不出这和你对待有史以来每一天的方式有什么不同。

lines.en: : It’s different because I’m wearing a swimsuit today and it makes me angry when you look at other girls who are doing the same.
lines.zh: : 不同在于我今天穿着泳装，而你去看别的同样穿着泳装的女孩，会让我生气。

lines.en: : Let go of my arm, Ami.
lines.zh: : 松开我的胳膊，Ami。

lines.en: : No.
scene norikoinvitexmas3

: You’ve had your fun looking for class delinquents and hiding behind buildings with my friends. Now, it’s Ami time. Which means that you must focus entirely on Ami and ignore anyone else who might show up.
lines.zh: : 你已经玩够了——去找班上的不良少女、跟我的朋友们躲在楼后面。现在，是 Ami 时间。意思是你必须把注意力完全放在 Ami 身上，无视任何可能出现的其他人。

lines.en: : Hi, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Noriko。

lines.en: : Ha ha ha. Very funny. Noriko would know better than to show up in the middle of Ami time. Especially since I would chop off her hands if she ever actually did.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。真好笑。Noriko 还不至于蠢到在 Ami 时间出现。尤其是她真敢出现的话，我会把她的手砍下来。

lines.en: : Maybe keep your dismemberment fetish to yourself while we’re out in public.
lines.zh: : 我们在外面的时候，你能不能把你的肢解癖藏在心里。

lines.en: : It’s not a fetish, it’s a necessity. Plus, does Noriko even really need hands in the first-
lines.zh: : 那不是癖好，是必需品。再说，Noriko 到底真的需不需要手——

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas4
: PlaAAAaAAAce!?
lines.zh: : 公……公公公公场所！？

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas5
: That was assault! I’m calling the police!
lines.zh: : 那是猥亵！我要报警了！

lines.en: : Soft, yet quite firm upon squeezing. And so very smooth. I’ve gotta say, Ami- you’ve got a surprisingly nice ass. I’d give it...an eight out of ten on the Noriko meter.
lines.zh: : 软，但捏起来相当紧实。而且非常光滑。我得说，Ami——你屁股意外地不错。我给它……Noriko 量表上的八分。

lines.en: : Stop ranking my butt! What do you want?! You’re interrupting Ami time!
lines.zh: : 别给我的屁股打分！你想干什么？！你在打扰 Ami 时间！

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas6
: I just wanted to see what my non-blood-related little sister and future husband are up to.
lines.zh: : 我只是想看看我没有血缘关系的妹妹和我未来的丈夫在忙什么。

lines.en: : But if Ami’s your sister, wouldn’t that make me-
lines.zh: : 可如果 Ami 是你妹妹，那我不就——

lines.en: : Shush. You know neither one of us really cares about that.
lines.zh: : 嘘。你知道我们俩谁都不在乎那个。

lines.en: : True. But on a more serious note, I feel like not enough people do.
lines.zh: : 确实。不过说正经的，我觉得在乎这件事的人还不够多。

lines.en: : What I am “up to” is spending time with my beloved uncle. Time that should not be interrupted by-
lines.zh: : 我「在忙」的是和我亲爱的 uncle 共度时光。这段时间不该被——

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas7
: Wha- and now you’re hugging me?! Why?!
lines.zh: : 什——现在你还抱我？！为什么？！

lines.en: : Because I love you, obviously!
lines.zh: : 因为我爱你，很明显！

lines.en: : Well, stop! How am I supposed to hate you when you keep being this adorable and kind?!
lines.zh: : 那就别抱了！你一直这么可爱又温柔，我怎么恨得起来？！

lines.en: : I need not your love, precious imouto. Just your pliable, berry-scented flesh and your 8/10 ass.
lines.zh: : 我不需要你的爱，亲爱的 imouto。我只要你柔韧的、带着浆果味的肉体，还有你那个 8/10 的屁股。

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas8
: Oh, and I also need to borrow Sensei for a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 噢，另外我还要借用 Sensei 几分钟。

lines.en: : There it is. You never cared about Ami time at all, did you?
lines.zh: : 来了。你根本就不在乎 Ami 时间，对吧？

lines.en: : I will be a happy and willing participant in Ami time right after I can talk to Sensei.
lines.zh: : 等我跟 Sensei 说完话，我会非常乐意地参加 Ami 时间。

lines.en: : Anything you need to say to Sensei, you can say in front of me.
lines.zh: : 你要跟 Sensei 说什么，都可以当着我的面说。

lines.en: : Not if I want to keep my hands, I can’t. And I like my hands. What else am I supposed to rank butts with?
lines.zh: : 如果我还想要我的手，那就不能当着你的面说。而我喜欢我的手。不然我拿什么给屁股打分？

lines.en: : Am I allowed to ask who the current top scorer in the ass ranking is?
lines.zh: : 我可以问一下目前屁股排行榜的第一名是谁吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, my unbiased judging has Maya sitting at the very top of the list right now.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，我那毫无偏见的评判目前让 Maya 高居榜首。

lines.en: : I can not imagine she would be happy to hear that.
lines.zh: : 我想她听到这个大概不会高兴。

lines.en: : Is that why Maya hates you so much? Have you assaulted her as well?
lines.zh: : 这就是 Maya 那么讨厌你的原因吗？你也袭击过她？

lines.en: : Only with my eyes. But I stare for longer periods of time at the people I’m jealous of and she has many things I wish I could have as well.
lines.zh: : 只用眼睛。不过我盯着看的时间更长的，是我嫉妒的人，而她有很多我也希望自己能拥有的东西。

lines.en: : But so do you, Ami! Which is why I was kind enough to once again ask for your permission to talk to Sensei rather than just stealing him away like everyone else always does.
lines.zh: : 可你也有啊，Ami！所以我才这么体贴地又一次来征求你的许可，而不是像其他人那样直接把他抢走。

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas9
: Well...I do like that you acknowledge your position in the pecking order. And if it weren’t Ami time right now, I’d be inclined to consider your plea.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我确实喜欢你承认自己在啄食顺序里的位置。而且如果不是现在正处在 Ami 时间，我倒会考虑你的请求。

lines.en: : But unfortunately for you, the only person who can override Ami time other than me is Sensei and there is no way he would ever-
lines.zh: : 但对你来说不幸的是，除了我之外唯一能推翻 Ami 时间的人就是 Sensei，而他绝对不可能会——

lines.en: : We can talk.
lines.zh: : 我们可以谈。

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas10
: Why does nobody ever care about Ami time?!
lines.zh: : 为什么就没人把 Ami 时间当回事？！

lines.en: : Because Noriko said whatever it is will only take a few minutes. After that, you can do whatever you want with me so long as it’s legal.
lines.zh: : 因为 Noriko 说了，不管是什么事都只花几分钟。在那之后，只要合法，你想对我做什么都行。

lines.en: : You’re going to make me study the law?! Since when do you care about what’s legal and what’s not?!
lines.zh: : 你要逼我去研究法律？！你什么时候开始在乎合不合法了？！

lines.en: : I’m just covering my bases now for when your ages are no longer indeterminate anymore.
lines.zh: : 我只是提前打个底，等你们的年龄不再是不确定值的时候好用。

lines.en: : But you know how old I am.
lines.zh: : 可你知道我多大。

lines.en: : I do. But they don’t.
lines.zh: : 我知道。可他们不知道。

lines.en: : Who are they?! What are you talking about?!
lines.zh: : 他们是谁？！你在说什么？！

lines.en: : I have no idea what’s going on, but follow me toward privacy! Or at least as close as we can get to it on a small beach with twenty-some-odd girls!
lines.zh: : 我不知道发生了什么，但跟我往私密的地方走！或者说，在一个挤着二十几个女孩的小海滩上，我们能凑到的最私密的地方！

lines.en: scene black
In complete disregard for her wishes, I leave Ami’s side and follow Noriko further down the shoreline.
lines.zh: 我完全无视了她的意愿，离开 Ami 身边，跟着 Noriko 沿着海岸线往更远处走。

lines.en: You know that unspoken and mildly-sexist rule where the male in a relationship is always supposed to walk closer to the street so that if ANYTHING HORRIBLE happens, it happens to him?
lines.zh: 你知道那条不成文又略微性别歧视的规矩吧——恋爱关系里的男性总是该走在靠马路那一侧，这样万一有什么可怕的事发生，就会落在他身上？

lines.en: Well, I’m not sure if that rule applies to the ocean or not. But, if it does, I shatter it into a million pieces as Noriko is not only walking closer to the ocean, but in it.
lines.zh: 嗯，我不确定那条规矩适不适用于大海。但如果适用，那我把它摔成了百万片，因为 Noriko 不只是走得更靠近海，她干脆就走在海里。

lines.en: Her feet kick up water each time a wave forces its way into our group of two. And while she does this in a playful fashion, humming happily as she goes, I can not help but mutate the situation inside of my head.
lines.zh: 每次海浪挤进我们这小小的两人组，她的脚就踢起水花。虽然她这么做只是出于玩耍，还一边开心地哼着歌，但我还是忍不住在脑子里把这一幕扭曲变形。

lines.en: A body of water is chopped into pieces.
lines.zh: 一片水被剁成碎块。

lines.en: I carry some of them with me as they soak into my jeans.
lines.zh: 我带着其中一些离开，它们渗进了我的牛仔裤。

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas11
: Sorry for pulling you away like that. I know just how important “Ami time” is to you.
lines.zh: : 抱歉把你拉走。我知道「Ami 时间」对你有多重要。

lines.en: : I feel like my life is perpetually caught in “Ami time,” so I welcome all chances to slip away from that. Even if most of those chances are thwarted soon after.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我的人生永远被困在「Ami 时间」里，所以任何能溜开的机会我都欢迎。哪怕这些机会大多数很快就被挫败了。

lines.en: : Then, what would you say if I offered you another opportunity to break free from the chains that bind you tomorrow night?
lines.zh: : 那么，如果我给你一个机会，让你明晚挣脱那条束缚你的锁链，你会怎么说？

lines.en: : I’d ask what we’re doing, where we’re going, and what you’ll be wearing.
lines.zh: : 我会问我们要做什么、要去哪里、还有你会穿什么。

lines.en: : Hanging out, around here, and this.
lines.zh: : 闲逛，就在这一带，还有这个。

lines.en: : Not going to whisk me away to another seedy bar in the urban district?
lines.zh: : 不打算把我拐到市区那家不入流的酒吧去？

lines.en: : I can if that’s what you want. I just figured a more relaxing Christmas date would be a little more comfortable for you.
lines.zh: : 如果你想的话我可以。我只是觉得，一个更放松的圣诞约会对你来说会舒服一点。

lines.en: Right...tomorrow is Christmas.
lines.zh: 对……明天是圣诞节。

lines.en: But wasn’t it Niki who asked me out first?
lines.zh: 可最先约我的不是 Niki 吗？

lines.en: Granted, I never agreed to go on a date with any of the three girls who asked me...but sticking with the first person who did seems to me like it would be the best way to avoid conflict.
lines.zh: 诚然，我从来没有答应过那三个约我的女孩中的任何一个……但跟着第一个开口的人走，在我看来是最能避免冲突的做法。

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, is this something I agreed to do over the last...two-ish months?
lines.zh: : 只是好奇，这是我在过去……大概两个月里答应过的事吗？

lines.en: : Hmm...to take advantage of your memory problems or to be honest...which one should I do?
lines.zh: : 嗯……是利用你的记忆问题，还是说实话……我该选哪个？

lines.en: : I’d prefer honesty but can’t say that’s the route I would take if I were in your shoes.
lines.zh: : 我更希望你说实话，可我要是处在你的位置，我也不能说我会选这条路。

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas12
: Eh. Both paths head to the same place anyway.
lines.zh: : 呃。反正两条路通向同一个地方。

lines.en: : You never responded to any of our date requests. So Nee-chan went ahead with her normal Christmas concert while Chika and I hung back and accepted that it just wasn’t something you were into.
lines.zh: : 你从没回复过我们任何人的约会请求。所以 Nee-chan 照常去办她的圣诞音乐会，而 Chika 和我退到一边，接受了「你就是不喜欢这种事」这个结论。

lines.en: : Well...until now, that is. Now, Noriko Nakayarakawayama is seizing the day! Or the...tomorrow...
lines.zh: : 不过……直到现在为止。现在，Noriko Nakayarakawayama 要抓住当下！或者说……抓住明天……

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas13
: ...and taking you... yes, you...out on what is sure to be the most mildly romantic and decently interesting Christmas date of all time.
lines.zh: : ……然后带上你……对，你……去赴一场有史以来最温和浪漫、还算有点意思的圣诞约会。

lines.en: : Wow, I’m sold. What an amazing pitch.
lines.zh: : 哇，我被说服了。多么精彩的推销。

lines.en: : I try.
lines.zh: : 我尽力了。

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas14
: On the real, though...there’s a place I found that I want to take you.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的……我找到了一个地方，想带你去。

lines.en: : It’s pretty hidden, so the chances of anyone seeing us together are null so long as we go there at separate times.
lines.zh: : 那地方很隐蔽，只要我们分开时间去，被人看见我们在一起的可能性就是零。

lines.en: : True. But you’re overlooking the part where it will be Christmas night, a time we almost always spend as a group, and only the two of us will be missing.
lines.zh: : 确实。但你忽略了一点——那会是圣诞夜，一个我们几乎总是全团一起过的时刻，而只有我们两个缺席。

lines.en: : I’m not overlooking that. I’m accepting it as a necessary risk if I’m ever going to get out of my prototype stage.
lines.zh: : 我没有忽略。我是把它当作必要的风险来接受，如果我还想走出我的原型阶段的话。

lines.en: : And with a brand new year on the horizon, it’s about time I start doing some things for myself.
lines.zh: : 而且新的一年就在眼前，我也该开始为自己做点事了。

lines.en: : And what better thing to do for yourself than throw everything you have at winning over a member of the “patriarchy” you so vehemently despise.
lines.zh: : 而有什么比把一切押在赢取一个你如此激烈厌恶的「父权制」成员的心上，更适合为自己做的事？

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas15
: I can fall in love and still advocate for change, you know. Those things aren’t mutually exclusive.
lines.zh: : 我可以一边坠入爱河，一边倡导变革，你知道的。这两件事并不互斥。

lines.en: : You don’t want to fall in love with me, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 你不会想爱上我的，Noriko。

lines.en: : No. You don’t want to fall in love with me because you’re worried you might break me. But I’m not as fragile as you think.
lines.zh: : 不。是你不想爱上我，因为你担心你会弄坏我。可我没有你想的那么脆弱。

lines.en: : And I’m not just saying that because I’d let you do the really rough stuff like choke me and strap me to weird sexual torture devices.
lines.zh: : 而且我不只是因为会让你对我做那些很粗暴的事——比如掐我脖子、把我绑在奇怪的性虐装置上——才这么说的。

lines.en: : Will any of those devices be at this secret spot you’ve managed to find for the two of us?
lines.zh: : 那些装置里会有几样在你给我们俩找到的那个秘密地点？

lines.en: : I might be able to make some arrangements.
lines.zh: : 我也许能安排一些。

lines.en: : Then sign me up. Nothing screams “Christmas” like taking the virginity of a teenage girl in an undisclosed location full of sex machines.
lines.zh: : 那给我报上名。没有什么比在一个布满性爱机器的秘密地点夺走一个十几岁女孩的童贞，更能喊出「圣诞」这两个字了。

lines.en: : Just make sure nobody follows you, okay? Not because I’m worried we’ll get caught, but because I don’t want them to be scarred for life after seeing what you’re putting me through.
lines.zh: : 只要保证没人跟着你就行，好吗？不是因为我担心我们会被抓，而是因为我不想让别人看到你对我做的事之后留下终身阴影。

lines.en: : Jokes aside, I’m not sure if it’s a good idea or not.
lines.zh: : 玩笑归玩笑，我不确定这是不是个好主意。

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas16
: Really? Not even for-
lines.zh: : 真的吗？连——都不行？

lines.en: : But I’ll do it anyway.
lines.zh: : 但我会去做的。

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas17
: You...will? Really?
lines.zh: : 你……会吗？真的？

lines.en: : I get to have you all to myself on the most romantic night of the year? You’re not going to forget about me and go spend it with Maya or something?
lines.zh: : 一年中最浪漫的夜晚，我能独占你？你不会忘了我、跑去和 Maya 一起过吧？

lines.en: : Nope. Tonight is Maya night. Tomorrow night will be Noriko night.
lines.zh: : 不会。今晚是 Maya 之夜。明晚是 Noriko 之夜。

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas18
: Aww...how generous of you. Thanks, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哇……你可真大方。谢谢，Sensei。

lines.en: : Jealous she beat you to the punch tonight as well? A more aggressive Noriko could have had dates two nights in a row.
lines.zh: : 嫉妒她今晚也抢先一步了？一个更主动的 Noriko 本来能连着两晚都有约会的。

lines.en: : I’m not jealous, no.
lines.zh: : 我不嫉妒，没有。

lines.en: : I’m happy I get to have you for any amount of time at all...
lines.zh: : 能拥有你哪怕一点点时间，我就很高兴了……

lines.en: scene black
$ noriko_love += 1
Noriko’s affection has increased to [noriko_love]!
lines.zh: Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]!

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas19
: What do you think they’re talking about over there?
lines.zh: : 你觉得他们在那边聊什么？

lines.en: : Sensei and Noriko? Beats me. But if I had to guess, probably somethin’ about how she’s loved him for like forty years or whatever it was.
lines.zh: : Sensei 和 Noriko？谁知道。不过要我猜，大概是她爱了他四十年还是什么的。

lines.en: : Did you know they haven’t even kissed yet? How ridiculous is that?
lines.zh: : 你知道他们连吻都还没接过吗？这有多离谱？

lines.en: : Crazy ridiculous. Like, even I’ve kissed Sensei. Way to drop the ball, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 离谱到家了。连我都亲过 Sensei。Noriko，你这球掉得可真行。

lines.en: : Right? Like, hurry the fuck up and-
lines.zh: : 对吧？就像，赶紧他妈的——

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas20
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : You and Sensei...have kissed?
lines.zh: : 你和 Sensei……接过吻？

lines.en: : Mhm.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。

lines.en: : When?
lines.zh: : 什么时候？

lines.en: : Almost a whole year ago at this point.
lines.zh: : 到现在快整整一年了。

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas21
: And you never told me about it?!
lines.zh: : 而你从来没跟我说过？！

lines.en: : Was I supposed to?
lines.zh: : 我应该说吗？

lines.en: : Well...we’re friends, aren’t we? I always thought I’d be one of the first people to hear about something like that.
lines.zh: : 那个……我们不是朋友吗？我一直以为这种事我会是最早听到的人之一。

lines.en: : I don’t really think I’m supposed to be tellin’ anybody. That kinda thing paints a target on your back ‘round these parts.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这种事本来就不该跟别人说。在这一带，那等于在自己背上画个靶子。

lines.en: : But as long as you don’t go around tellin’ anyone else, I don’t think it’ll be a problem. Only you and Makoto know right now.
lines.zh: : 但只要你不去到处跟别人说，我觉得不会有问题。目前只有你和 Makoto 知道。

lines.en: : Miku, what the fuck?
lines.zh: : Miku，你搞什么鬼？

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas22
: I don’t really see what the big deal is with other people knowin’, but if it keeps Sensei outta trouble and my kneecaps still workin’, that’s enough for me.
lines.zh: : 我不太明白别人知道有什么大不了的，但只要能让 Sensei 不惹上麻烦、我的膝盖骨还能用，对我来说就够了。

lines.en: : So, like...are you saying you wouldn’t get pissed off hearing about somebody else making moves on the guy you like?
lines.zh: : 那么，比如……你是说，听到别人对你喜欢的那个男人出手，你也不会生气？

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas23
: Mm-mm. Makoto’s liked Sensei way longer than I have and I’d be super happy if he ever decided to make her his girlfriend. I just also want to be that too. I think. I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: : 嗯-嗯。Makoto 喜欢 Sensei 的时间比我长得多，如果他哪天真决定让她当女朋友，我会超级开心。只是我也想当那个。我想。我不太确定。

lines.en: : Then...say if someone like me were to also...you know...
lines.zh: : 那么……假如像我这样的人也……你知道的……

lines.en: : Kiss Sensei?
lines.zh: : 亲 Sensei？

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas24
: Or do...more...
lines.zh: : 或者做……更多……

lines.en: : More?
lines.zh: : 更多？

lines.en: : Yeah...like...
scene norikoinvitexmas25
: Wait, did he do that fingering thing on you too?
lines.zh: : 等等，他也对你做过那个用手指的事？

lines.en: : What the fuck is going on right now?!
lines.zh: : 现在到底是什么情况？！

lines.en: : Isn’t it, like...really weird? But also kind of amazing? Unless you guys haven’t done that yet. But if not, you’ve gotta try it. He’s really good.
lines.zh: : 是不是……挺奇怪的？但也挺棒的？除非你们还没做过那个。不过要是没做过，你一定得试试。他真的很厉害。

lines.en: : Not like I’ve got anythin’ to compare it to, but still.
lines.zh: : 我也没什么可比较的，不过还是。

lines.en: : Sensei...has fingered you?
lines.zh: : Sensei……用手指弄过你？

lines.en: : Yeah. A bunch of times. It's friggin' awesome.
lines.zh: : 对。好多次。爽死了。

lines.en: if kirinlust30 == True:
scene norikoinvitexmas26
: So all of that...shit I felt at the end of the Dorm Wars...was for nothing?
lines.zh: : 那我在宿舍战争结束时感受到的那些……破玩意儿，都是白费了？

lines.en: : What happened at the end of the Dorm Wars? I don’t really remember anything after-
lines.zh: : 宿舍战争结束的时候发生了什么？我其实什么都不记得了，在——

lines.en: else:
: How am I only finding out about this right now?
lines.zh: : 我怎么现在才知道这件事？

lines.en: : Idunno. Guess I’m just really good at keepin’ secrets.
lines.zh: : 不知道。大概我就是特别会保守秘密吧。

lines.en: : This what they call bein’ a side-piece? Cause it ain’t half bad.
lines.zh: : 这就是所谓的「备胎」吗？因为感觉还不赖。

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas27
: You two haven’t...had sex yet, have you?
lines.zh: : 你们两个……还没做过爱吧？

lines.en: : Sex? The whole shabang? You crazy? You have any idea how big that thing is, Kirin? Fingers are one thing, but I ain’t about to let Sensei shove his whole forearm up there.
lines.zh: : 做爱？全套？你疯了吗？你知道那玩意儿有多大吗，Kirin？手指是一回事，我可不会让 Sensei 把整条前臂都塞进去。

lines.en: : Ain’t no way I’m ready for that. Nuh-uh. Nope.
lines.zh: : 我绝对还没准备好迎接那个。不不。不行。

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas28
: Oh, thank god. You’re not entirely corrupted yet.
lines.zh: : 噢，谢天谢地。你还没被彻底带坏。

lines.en: : I mean...it might just feel bigger than it actually is since I ain’t ever technically seen it...but from what I felt back during Halloween a few years ago...no way. I like bein’ able to walk.
lines.zh: : 我是说……它也许只是感觉比实际更大，毕竟严格来说我从没真正见过它……但从几年前万圣节那时我摸到的来看……不可能。我还想能走路呢。

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas29
: Miku...between you and me...
lines.zh: : Miku……就我们俩之间说……

lines.en: : It looks even bigger than it feels. You’ve gotta see it up close.
lines.zh: : 它看起来比摸起来还大。你得近距离看看。

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas30
: Ah! I knew all that experience you’re always talkin’ about came from somewhere! I just always thought it was random guys you met in town and not our teacher!
lines.zh: : 啊！我就知道你老是挂在嘴边的那些经验是从哪儿来的！我一直以为是你在镇上随便认识的男人，而不是我们的老师！

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas31
: Miku, I’m not going to have sex with random guys I meet in town! Even I’m better than that!
lines.zh: : Miku，我不会跟在镇上随便认识的男人上床的！我再怎么样也不至于那样！

lines.en: : You’re only sayin’ that cause there ain’t any guys around! And wait a minute, you put that thing inside of you?!
lines.zh: : 你这么说只是因为周围没有男人！等等，你把那个东西放进去了？！

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas32
: SHH! Someone’s going to hear you!
lines.zh: : 嘘！会有人听见的！

lines.en: : How can you still walk?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么还能走路？！

lines.en: : Wait a minute! Is that why you were gonna quit the soccer team?! Because Sensei messed up your-
lines.zh: : 等等！这就是你当初要退出足球队的原因吗？！因为 Sensei 把你的——

lines.en: scene norikoinvitexmas33
: Stop yelling about it like that! It’s embarrassing!
lines.zh: : 别那么大声喊这个！太丢人了！
